verdict.rationale: IP India publishes an official Electronic Register of Patent Agents and lists of sanctioned facilitators (IP Mitras under the SIPP scheme, Design facilitators), which together form a sanctioned third-party rail of registered representatives. The pack, however, contains only navigation titles and does not describe how an agent is authorized to act for a company. missing for 10: documented authorization/power-of-attorney mechanics for appointing an agent, scope of what agents can do in e-filing on the applicant's behalf, trademark/GI agent coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
